text: O Jippinii e dow maaɗa an Muhammadu, ndee Qur'aanaare e hoore goonga. Ko nde goongunde ka kabaruuji, nunnɗunde ka ñaawooje, yahdunde e kon ko adinoonde immorde e Defte Alla; ɗe luutorndiraa hakkunde majje. O Jippini kadi Tawreeta e dow Muusaa, Linnjiila e dow Iisaa (yo ɓe his) ko adii Qur'aana jippaade e maaɗa. Ɗee Defte Alla fow ko fewnayɗe yimɓe ɓen moƴƴinanaɓe diina e aduna maɓɓe. O Jippini kadi Al Qur'aana senndinraynde hakkunde goonga e fenaande, peewal e majjere. Ɓen yedduɓe ɓen non Aayeeje Alla Jippinaaɗe e maaɗa ɗen, hino woodani ɓe lepte saɗtuɗe. Alla Ko Fooluɗo, Jom-yottagol kala fennuɗo Nulaaɓe Makko ɓen lunndii Yamirooje Makko ɗen.
